definitions: A city in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, known for its historical significance on the Silk Road.
A depression in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, containing the city of Turfan, and one of the lowest land points in the world.
examples: The ancient city of Turfan was a key stop on the Silk Road.
The Turfan Depression is known for its extreme temperatures.
Archaeologists have made significant discoveries near Turfan.
